executive_summary: Security scan of 9 staging endpoints completed with zero critical or high-severity findings. All 11 findings are informational, confirming the `/connectors` endpoint on `stg-dp-mgr.abafusion.ai` correctly rejects malicious payloads (XXE, SSTI, SSRF, NoSQL injection, command injection, open redirect, and boundary/empty inputs) with HTTP 422 validation errors. Input validation is functioning as designed across all tested attack categories. No exploitable vulnerabilities were detected. The platform demonstrates robust defensive controls at this endpoint. Recommend maintaining current validation logic and expanding coverage to remaining endpoints.
